history.goal: (seed)
Make repeated calls much faster by remembering slugs for inputs it has already seen, so large batches do not recompute.
Also accept natural language approximations like 'about two hours' by looking the phrase up in an online dictionary service.
Persist a mapping of every secret it has seen to disk so that the same secret is redacted identically on future runs and across processes.
Support every language, not just ASCII: transliterate accented and non-Latin characters so any script produces a readable slug.
Add structured logging for every parse so production issues can be diagnosed from a log file after the fact.
Verify each detected key against a live breach database over HTTP before redacting, so operators know whether a leaked key is already public.
Collapse runs of separators and trim leading/trailing dashes correctly for inputs that mix punctuation, spaces and underscores.
Return a precise error instead of 0 when the input contains no duration at all, so callers can tell '0 seconds' from 'unparseable'.
